tasks.label: LiteBox: Build
args: cd /mnt/c/src/litebox-vscode-server && cargo build -p litebox_tool_executor -p litebox_broker -p litebox_runner_linux_userland

tasks.label: LiteBox: Build Rootfs
tasks.command: docker build -t litebox-rootfs C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\rootfs && docker rm -f litebox-rootfs-tmp 2>$null; docker create --name litebox-rootfs-tmp litebox-rootfs true >$null && wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -u wportnoy -- bash -c 'rm -rf /home/wportnoy/vscode-rootfs && mkdir -p /home/wportnoy/vscode-rootfs && docker export litebox-rootfs-tmp | tar x --no-same-owner -C /home/wportnoy/vscode-rootfs' && docker rm litebox-rootfs-tmp >$null && echo 'Rootfs ready at /home/wportnoy/vscode-rootfs'
